paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on BioGPT.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy change (ACC) as a function of co-occurrence number for various language models. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and represents a linear scale ranging from 1.0 to 10,000, with tick labels spaced evenly at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and represents a percentage value, ranging from 21% to 55%, with tick intervals of 5. The black line, marked with circular markers, represents the Base model, starting at approximately 31% and ending around 44%. The brown line, characterized by diamond markers, depicts the MEND model, beginning at approximately 35% and concluding at approximately 46%. The cyan line, indicated by triangular markers, visualizes the FT model, starting around 33% and reaching approximately 41%. The magenta line, shown with square markers, represents the MEMIT model, beginning at approximately 37% and ending around 45%. Finally, the red line, using hexagonal markers, shows the IKE model, starting around 38% and ending around 43%.
